stories.title: Not Our Problem
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 2 & 14 - the course just surrendered

stories.title: Not Our Problem
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 9 & 15 - the course just surrendered

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: Turned it on - 22 coming home vs 16 out

stories.title: Hot Hole
stories.detail: gave up 23 threes today - the pin was there for the taking

stories.detail: 11 wipes handed out - where cards go to die

stories.title: Golden Hole
stories.detail: the field's happy place - averaged 2.4 points

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 204 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: Relatively Good Golf
stories.detail: Kim and Beverley Robinson both scoring well - must have shared the good clubs today

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 3 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 5 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 17 & 18 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 16, 17 & 18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Short Memory
stories.detail: 2 wipes, every one followed by a score - forgets fast

stories.title: The Phoenix
stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - drama then redemption

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 20, back nine 12 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: Clean but Not Pretty
stories.detail: 7 1-pointers and not a single wipe - disciplined mediocrity

stories.title: The Opportunist
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ from 18 holes - takes the chances when they come

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 4 twos on the bounce on holes 15-18

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Rough Patch
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - club still in the bag

stories.title: The Sieve
stories.detail: 8 wipes in 18 holes - the points have somewhere better to be

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Dianne Pomeroy down to 13th - was 2nd before the round bit back
